mingob2019.name: Compendio Estadístico 2019 - section 1.2.7 Número de homicidios por departamento and Annex (a) Tasa de homicidios (por cada 10,000 habitantes) por municipio
mingob2019.publisher: Ministerio de Gobernación de Guatemala (MINGOB); data: Policía Nacional Civil - Sección de Estadística via INE
mingob2019.notes: PDF (raw/mingob_compendio_2019.pdf) extracted with pdftotext -layout. Municipal annex sum = department table total (2019: 3,578; 2020: 2,572). Municipal rates are published per 10,000 inhabitants (unit "rate per 10,000"); department rates per 100,000. In the 2019 annex, municipalities with no homicides show "-" with rate 0.0; recorded here as count 0. Population columns are not copied.

hdx_inform.name: Guatemala Personas afectadas por la violencia año 2015 - file "1.2.1.A Personas afectadas por la violencia.xlsx" (INFORM Guatemala subnational risk model), sheet "340"
hdx_inform.publisher: Source: Ministerio de Gobernación (MINGOB) / Policía Nacional Civil (PNC); published on HDX by OCHA ROLAC
hdx_inform.licence: Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY) - as stated on the HDX dataset page
hdx_inform.notes: Only the column "TASA Homicidios" is copied (population and Human Development Index columns are not homicide data). The sheet header says "Indicador: Tasa de Homicidios", "Año: 2014", but its "Fuente" line reads "HOMICIDIOS MENSUALES EN LOS DEPARTAMENTOS DE GUATEMALA DURANTE 2015" and the HDX title says 2015; year recorded as 2014 per the "Año" field - treat the year as uncertain. The rate unit is not stated (values look like per 100,000, e.g. Guatemala municipality 74.6). Sheet "85" repeats a subset of the same municipalities with identical rates. area_id = Código Municipio.
